source: Actual UCI digit inference over HTTP; recorded real documentation RAG output/judgment replay
demo: Named scripted operator; live model predictions and local mitigation; RAG replay is labeled, not new inference or independent human validation

vision_manifest.dataset: UCI handwritten digits, sklearn bundled original-test subset
vision_manifest.attribution: Alpaydin and Kaynak (1998), DOI 10.24432/C50P49, CC BY 4.0

scenes.caption: Named operator monitors an actual hooked digit service
A real held-out digit prediction passes the frozen confidence gate
A natural low-confidence prediction is withheld and persisted for review
Authenticated incident ownership records who is investigating
The application resolves against the real benchmark label and sends an outcome
Mitigation follows application resolution and an audited response inspection
Durable metadata delivery reports accepted traffic through a separate heartbeat
Replay of a recorded real RAG answer flags its unsupported enforcement claim
Frozen engineering calibration exposes captured risks, misses and false positives
The receipt retains coverage, source positions and hashes while text stays transient
